verdict_schema_note: Schema-level verdict enum [APPROVE, APPROVE_CONDITIONAL, REVISE, REJECT, PASS, FAIL] is bound here as 'FAIL' because LRO does NOT satisfy production PASS gate. Plan §12 verdict (4-class semantic) is judge_decision.verdict='MONITORING_ONLY' — distinct from schema FAIL because LRI predictive power IS validated and LRO methodology retained for monitoring role. Schema-level FAIL = 'does not pass production admission'; Plan-level MONITORING_ONLY = 'recommendation_only ABORTED with LRI tracker retained'. State machine target = JUDGE_PASSED (judge_package_complete, NOT production admission per Plan §11 8차 BLOCKER).

judge_decision.rationale: LRO active interventions (cap/cash) do NOT meaningfully improve MDD or crisis vol vs forge_recomputed_M4 baseline in 268m full backtest. Only M4+LRO_cash variant achieves +0.42pp MDD improvement vs M4 (Plan §12 Rule #2 minimum -3pp threshold NOT met; below 1pp CONDITIONAL_PASS minimum) at cost of -1.52pp CAGR. LRI predictive power CONFIRMED (HighRisk fwd 1M vol 0.402 vs Normal 0.233 = 1.71× ratio in S1; 1.51× in M4) — supports MONITORING role. No variant satisfies the 9-of-9 PASS gate. FAIL not appropriate either: LRI state has documented predictive power (ax001_v2_pass=true; ES95 amplification 1.51×; forward 1M vol amplification 1.46-1.71×) — overlay retained for risk monitoring. CONDITIONAL_PASS not appropriate: Plan §12 minimum '+1~3pp MDD' threshold not met.
